t: Platinum Disc Corporation - Audiovisual Identity Database
s: January 4, 2026 - Platinum Disc Corporation was an American public domain/budget home video company based in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Platinum was founded in 1995 to release DVDs of public domain films for a cheaper price than other companies. Despite their name, Platinum also produced VHS tapes, though these are uncommon.
